docs.html:
Menu

useEffect

useEffect lets a component synchronize with an external system such as a network connection or a browser API.

Cleanup

Return a cleanup function from the setup function. React calls cleanup before the effect runs again with new dependencies, and when the component unmounts.

useEffect(() => {
  const conn = createConnection(roomId);
  conn.connect();
  return () => conn.disconnect();
}, [roomId]);

Strict Mode

In development with Strict Mode, React runs one extra setup and cleanup cycle right after mount to check that cleanup undoes setup. This does not happen in production.

Footer

Using the Effect Hook

The Effect Hook combines what class components did in componentDidMount, componentDidUpdate and componentWillUnmount.

Effects with cleanup

If your effect returns a function, React runs it when it is time to clean up, replacing the componentWillUnmount lifecycle method.

useEffect(() => {
  ChatAPI.subscribe(props.friend.id, handleChange);
  return () => ChatAPI.unsubscribe(props.friend.id, handleChange);
});

Dependencies

Declare a dependency by adding a parameter with Depends() to a path operation function. FastAPI calls the dependency for each request and passes the result in.

from typing import Annotated
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

async def common_parameters(q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100):
    return {"q": q, "skip": skip, "limit": limit}

@app.get("/items/")
async def read_items(commons: Annotated[dict, Depends(common_parameters)]):
    return commons

Dependencies with yield

A dependency that uses yield runs its code after the yield once the response is sent, which suits closing a database session.

question.title: Why does my useEffect run twice on mount?
question.body: My useEffect with an empty dependency array logs twice when the page loads. Is this a bug?

answers.body: This is React Strict Mode in development. It mounts, unmounts and mounts again to surface missing cleanup. Production builds run the effect once. Fix the effect so cleanup undoes setup instead of removing Strict Mode.
